feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 21 May 2026 11:59am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 21 May 2026 at 12:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Largely dry, with a small area of light rain moving through later this afternoon. Cloudy and misty across southern and central areas, while northern and western parts see some brighter spells. The mist will clear into the evening, with further brightness developing for many. Fresh southerly winds, backing southeast and easing for a time this evening, with temperatures reaching 17°C in the north.

Dry tonight, then dry for much of tomorrow with warm sunny spells in places, especially in the north, but always a risk of mist and low cloud around central and southern coasts and hills.


##Outlook##

A largely fine and dry weekend, with decent spells of sunshine and temperatures in the high teens. However, mist may affect some coasts at times.
